description: This Java class 'ImageFetcher' is a utility for fetching, resizing, and caching images from URLs in an Android project. It extends 'ImageResizer' and manages HTTP caching, network checks, and image processing asynchronously.

classes.name: ImageFetcher
classes.description: A subclass of ImageResizer that handles fetching images from the internet, caching, and resizing them for display in an Android application.

methods.name: ImageFetcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing with target image dimensions and setting up caches.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the object, checking network connection and setting cache directory.

methods.name: initDiskCacheInternal
methods.description: Initializes disk cache in parent, then in HTTP cache.

methods.name: initHttpDiskCache
methods.description: Creates HTTP disk cache if storage space permits.

methods.name: clearCacheInternal
methods.description: Clears both memory and HTTP disk caches.

methods.name: flushCacheInternal
methods.description: Flushes the HTTP disk cache to persistent storage.

methods.name: closeCacheInternal
methods.description: Closes and releases resources associated with HTTP disk cache.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks network connectivity and warns user if none.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Downloads, caches, and decodes the bitmap from a URL.

methods.name: downloadUrlToStream
methods.description: Downloads image data from URL and writes to output stream.

methods.name: disableConnectionReuseIfNecessary
methods.description: Disables HTTP connection reuse on older Android versions due to bugs.
